# Android native runtime notices

`NDK-r29-LLVM-NOTICE.txt` is copied unchanged from the pinned Android NDK 29.0.14206865 distribution at `toolchains/llvm/prebuilt/darwin-x86_64/NOTICE`. It retains the upstream libc++, libc++abi, LLVM exception, and related runtime notices.

The Android build also copies the active pinned NDK's full `NOTICE`, `NOTICE.toolchain`, and LLVM `NOTICE` into the AAR under `assets/orbit-licenses`. The packaged notice manifest records their hashes. No NDK tools or source trees are included in the AAR.

These files preserve upstream attribution. They do not establish legal review or approval for a product release.
